### FAIR WORK REGULATIONS 2009 - REG 3.46

**Pay slips--information to be included in pay slips**

(1) For [paragraph](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s7.08.html#paragraph)536(2)(b) of the Act, a pay slip must
specify:

(a) the employer's name; and

(b) the employee's name; and

(c) the period to which the pay slip relates; and

(d) the date on which the payment to which the pay slip relates
was made; and

(e) the gross amount of the payment; and

(f) the net amount of the payment; and

(g) any amount paid to the employee that is a bonus, loading,
allowance, penalty rate, incentive \- based payment or other separately
identifiable entitlement; and

(h) on and after 1 January 2010--the Australian Business
Number (if any) of the employer.

(2) If one or more amounts are deducted from the gross amount of
the payment under [subsection](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s7.14.html#subsection)324(1) of the Act, the pay slip must also
include, for each deduction:

(a) the amount of the deduction; and

(b) the name, or the name and number, of the fund or account
into which the deduction was paid.

(3) If the employee is paid at an hourly rate of pay, the pay
slip must also include:

(a) the rate of pay for the employee's ordinary hours
(however described); and

(b) the number of hours in that period for which the employee
was employed at that rate; and

(c) the amount of the payment made at that rate.

(4) If the employee is paid at an annual rate of pay, the pay
slip must also include the rate as at the latest date to which the payment
relates.

(5) If the employer has made, or intends to make, superannuation
[contributions](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s3.46.html#contributions) for the benefit of the employee, the pay slip must also include:

(a) the amount of each contribution that the employer made
during the period to which the pay slip relates, and the name, or the name and
number, of any fund to which the contribution was made; or

(b) the amounts of [contributions](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s3.46.html#contributions) that the employer intends to
make in relation to the period to which the pay slip relates, and the name, or
the name and number, of any fund to which the [contributions](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s3.46.html#contributions) will be made.

(5A) For the purposes of subregulation (5), a pay slip is
not required to include the name, or the name and number, of a fund if:

(a) the pay slip is required to be given to the employee within
the period of 14 days commencing on the first day on which the employer pays
an amount to the employee in relation to the performance of work; and

(b) by the time the pay slip is given to the employee:

(i) there is no chosen fund for the employee (within the meaning
of Division 4 of Part 3A of the [Superannuation](http://www.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_act/sga1992430/) [Guarantee\\
(Administration) Act 1992](http://www.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_act/sga1992430/)); and

(ii) the Commissioner of Taxation has not notified the employer
or the employer's agent (as applicable), in accordance with section 32R of that Act, of whether the Commissioner is satisfied that there is a
stapled fund for the employee or, if the Commissioner is satisfied that there
is a stapled fund, of the details of the fund.

(6) In subregulation (5):

"contributions" does not include a contribution in respect of a defined
benefit interest (within the meaning of the
[Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Regulations](http://www.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/sir1994582/) [1994](http://www.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/sir1994582/)) in a defined
benefit fund (within the meaning of the
[Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993](http://www.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_act/sia1993473/)).

Note: Subsection 536(2) of the Act is a [civil remedy provision](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s4.03.html#civil_remedy_provision).
Section 558 of the Act and Division 4 of Part 4 \- 1 deal
with [infringement notices](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s4.03.html#infringement_notice) relating to alleged [contraventions](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s4.03.html#contravention) of
[civil remedy provisions](https://classic.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_reg/fwr2009223/s4.03.html#civil_remedy_provision).
